records.jp: お兄ちゃん……来てくれると思ってたよ
records.en_original: Big brother... I knew you'd come.
records.en: Onii-chan... I knew you'd come.

records.jp: また口調が戻ってる……、<CR>どっちが本物のかんななのかな？
records.en_original: You're back to talking like that... Which is the real Kanna?
records.en: You're back to talking like that...<CR>Which is the real Kanna?

records.jp: わからない。<CR>ずっと、一緒にいたというのに……
records.en_original: I don't know. Even though we've always been together.
records.en: I don't know.<CR>Even though we've always been together.

records.jp: 星谷さん、大丈夫ですか？<CR>ケガとかしてませんか？
records.en_original: Kanna, are you all right? You're not hurt or anything, are you?
records.en: Hoshiya-san, are you all right?<CR>You're not hurt or anything, are you?

records.jp: うん、元気いっぱい
records.en_original: Yeah, I'm totally fine!
records.en: Yeah, I'm totally fine!

records.jp: そうですか。<CR>ならよかった……
records.en_original: I see. I'm glad, then...
records.en: I see.<CR>I'm glad, then...

records.jp: 本当は、みんなを使ってもっと思い出を<CR>詰め込みたかったけど……もう時間ないし
records.en_original: Honestly, I wanted to pack in even more memories with everyone, but there's just no more time.
records.en: Honestly, I wanted to pack in even more memories with everyone,<CR>but there's just no more time.

records.jp: まぁ、前回よりはマシか。<CR>だいぶ持った方でしょ
records.en_original: Well, at least it's better than last time. It lasted a lot longer, didn't it?
records.en: Well, at least it's better than last time.<CR>It lasted a lot longer, didn't it?

records.jp: かんな、何を言ってるの？
records.en_original: Kanna, what are you talking about?
records.en: Kanna, what are you talking about?

records.jp: ねえ、お兄ちゃん
records.en_original: Hey, big brother.
records.en: Hey, Onii-chan.

records.jp: かんなと、みんなのために……
records.en_original: If it was for me and everyone else...
records.en: For Kanna and everyone...

records.jp: 死んでくれる？
records.en_original: Would you die for us?
records.en: Would you die for us?

records.jp: リーダー！？
records.en_original: Leader?!
records.en: Leader?!

records.jp: なっ！？　今のはなんだ、何をした！？
records.en_original: Wha?! What was that just now—what did you do?!
records.en: Wha?! What was that just now—what did you do?!

records.jp: あーもう、逃げないでよ
records.en_original: Geez, don't run away!
records.en: Geez, don't run away!

records.jp: 大丈夫。今すぐにってわけじゃないから。<CR>やってもらいたいことがあるし
records.en_original: It's okay. It doesn't have to be right this second. There's something I want you to do first.
records.en: It's okay. It doesn't have to be right this second.<CR>There's something I want you to do first.

records.jp: ただちょっと拘束させてもらうだけ
records.en_original: I just need to restrain you a little bit.
records.en: I just need to restrain you a little bit.

records.jp: コモンと現実世界を遮断したのに、入ってきちゃったか
records.en_original: So even though I cut the Common off from the real world, you still came in?
records.en: So even though I cut the Common off from the real world, you still came in?

records.jp: まぁ、いずれあなたをコモンに連れて行こうと<CR>思ってたけど
records.en_original: Well, I always thought I'd end up bringing you to the Common eventually.
records.en: Well, I always thought I'd end up bringing you to the Common<CR>eventually.

records.jp: やっぱりあなたは特別なんだね
records.en_original: You really are special, you know.
records.en: You really are special, you know.

records.jp: この１年間、色々なことがあったよね
records.en_original: So much has happened this past year, right?
records.en: So much has happened this past year, right?

records.jp: いつも無邪気なふりしてたけど……<CR>本当は色々考えてたの、気づいてた？
records.en_original: I always pretended to be carefree...but did you ever realize I was really thinking a lot about things?
records.en: I always pretended to be carefree...but did you<CR>ever realize I was really thinking a lot about things?

records.jp: あなたの能力……。<CR>いつ心を覗かれるかって、ずっと緊張してた
records.en_original: Your ability... I was always on edge, wondering when you'd peek into my heart.
records.en: Your ability...<CR>I was always on edge, wondering when you'd peek into my heart.

records.jp: けど、実際覗かれてみたら……。<CR>案外わからないものね？　拍子抜けした
records.en_original: But when you actually did look, it turned out you couldn't really tell at all, could you? It was honestly anticlimactic.
records.en: But when you actually did look, it turned out you couldn't<CR>really tell at all, could you? It was honestly anticlimactic.

records.jp: 「時間がない、要求があるなら早く言え」
records.en_original: There's no time. If you have demands, say them now.
records.en: There's no time. If you have demands, say them now.

records.jp: うん……。じゃあ、話す。<CR>ねえ、リーダー……
records.en_original: Yeah. All right, I'll tell you. Hey, Leader...
records.en: Yeah. All right, I'll tell you.<CR>Hey, Leader...

records.jp: 二人でセカイを作ろう？<CR>この退屈なモラトリアムを終わらせて、新しいセカイを
records.en_original: Let's create a new world together, just the two of us. Let's end this boring limbo and start something new.
records.en: Let's create a new world together,<CR>just the two of us. Let's end this boring limbo and start something new.

records.jp: 知ってる？　この世界のこと。<CR>幾何級数的に消滅していってるって
records.en_original: Do you know? About this world, I mean. It's vanishing at a geometric rate.
records.en: Do you know? About this world, I mean.<CR>It's vanishing at a geometric rate.

records.jp: つい一週間前までは、世界が消えるなんて、<CR>誰も本気で思ってなかったよね？
records.en_original: Up until just a week ago, nobody actually believed the world would disappear, right?
records.en: Up until just a week ago, nobody actually believed<CR>the world would disappear, right?

records.jp: でも昨日の段階では、５０％が消滅したみたい。<CR>灰が降り始めてからここまでで、およそ２年
records.en_original: But as of yesterday, it seems fifty percent is gone. It's been about two years since the Ash started falling.
records.en: But as of yesterday, it seems fifty percent is gone.<CR>It's been about two years since the Ash started falling.

records.jp: さて問題です。<CR>残り半分の世界が消滅するまで、あと――
records.en_original: So here's a question: How long until the rest of the world disappears?
records.en: So here's a question:<CR>How long until the rest of the world disappears?

records.jp: 何“時間”でしょうか
records.en_original: As a hint, you should answer in hours.
records.en: As a hint, you should answer in hours.

records.jp: わたしの世界は、この世界から少しだけ<CR>分岐がずれた世界線
records.en_original: My world is on a timeline just a little bit off from this one.
records.en: My world is on a timeline just a little<CR>bit off from this one.

records.jp: だから何度も何度もこの世界をやり直して、<CR>“正解”の選択肢を、想いを全て集める
records.en_original: So I've replayed this world over and over, gathering all the right decisions and feelings.
records.en: So I've replayed this world over and over,<CR>gathering all the right decisions and feelings.

records.jp: そしてリーダーを核に、世界を創り直す
records.en_original: Then, I'll use you as the core to rebuild the world, Leader.
records.en: Then, I'll use you as the core to rebuild the world, Leader.

records.jp: わたしが元いた世界……<CR>壊れてしまった世界の続きを
records.en_original: The world that I came from... I'll continue that broken world.
records.en: The world that I came from...<CR>I'll continue that broken world.

records.en_original: *Gasp*
records.en: *Gasp*

records.jp: 愛央……彩未……
records.en_original: Ao... Ayami...
records.en: Ao... Ayami...

records.jp: 前にさ、かんな、こんなこと聞いてきたよね
records.en_original: You asked me this before, right, Kanna?
records.en: You asked me this before, right, Kanna?

records.jp: ……どっちもすっごく大事なものなんだけど、<CR>どっちか捨てなきゃいけなくなったら
records.en_original: If you had two things you cared about so much, but had to give up one...
records.en: If you had two things you cared about so much,<CR>but had to give up one...

records.jp: 愛央はどうする？
records.en_original: What would you do, Ao?
records.en: What would you do, Ao?

records.jp: そしてあの時私は……
records.en_original: And back then, I...
records.en: And back then, I...

records.jp: みんなが最終的に笑顔になれる方を取る、かな
records.en_original: I think I said I'd choose the option that would make everyone smile in the end.
records.en: I think I said I'd choose the option that would make everyone smile in the end.

records.jp: たとえ自分にとって苦しい選択肢でも
records.en_original: Even if it was a tough choice for me.
records.en: Even if it was a tough choice for me.

records.jp: それでみんなが“退屈で平凡な毎日”を送れるなら、<CR>それが一番幸せだと思う
records.en_original: If everyone else can live ordinary, peaceful days because of it, then that's probably the happiest ending.
records.en: If everyone else can live ordinary, peaceful days because of it,<CR>then that's probably the happiest ending.

records.jp: でも本当は、そんなきれいごとを<CR>聞きたかったわけじゃないよね？
records.en_original: But, the truth is, that's not really what you wanted to hear, was it?
records.en: But, the truth is, that's not really<CR>what you wanted to hear, was it?

records.jp: 止めてほしかったんだよね？
records.en_original: You wanted me to stop you, right?
records.en: You wanted me to stop you, right?

records.jp: 私、思い出したよ。全部
records.en_original: I remember now. Everything.
records.en: I remember now. Everything.

records.jp: 私も、かんなと同じように、<CR>何度も繰り返し同じ世界を生きてきた
records.en_original: Just like you, Kanna, I've also lived through the same world over and over again.
records.en: Just like you, Kanna,<CR>I've also lived through the same world over and over again.

records.jp: だから、ちょっとだけ賢くなったんだ
records.en_original: So I got a little wiser.
records.en: So I got a little wiser.

records.jp: それで、彩未を連れてきたの？
records.en_original: Is that why you brought Ayami with you?
records.en: Is that why you brought Ayami with you?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: 安く見られたものね。<CR>バディでも呼べば、絆されると思った？
records.en_original: So that's how little you think of me. Did you really think I'd be swayed just because you called my partner over?
records.en: So that's how little you think of me.<CR>Did you really think I'd be swayed just because you called my partner over?

records.jp: 悪いけど、そんな薄っぺらなお友達ごっこで<CR>わたしの気持ちは揺るがない
records.en_original: Sorry, but my feelings won't budge from some flimsy pretend friendship like that.
records.en: Sorry, but my feelings won't budge from some flimsy<CR>pretend friendship like that.

records.jp: ごめんね、ずっと嘘ついてて
records.en_original: Sorry for lying to you all this time.
records.en: Sorry for lying to you all this time.

records.jp: でも、これがわたしの……覚悟なの
records.en_original: But...this is what I've decided to do.
records.en: But...this is what I've decided to do.

records.jp: うん、知ってるよ
records.en_original: Yeah, I know.
records.en: Yeah, I know.

records.jp: だから、説得しに来たわけじゃない
records.en_original: That's why I'm not here to try and talk you out of it.
records.en: That's why I'm not here to try and talk you out of it.

records.jp: 力づくで止めに来たの
records.en_original: I'm here to stop you by force.
records.en: I'm here to stop you by force.

records.jp: 普段の任務から、彩未が本気を出してないのは<CR>なんとなく気づいてた
records.en_original: I kind of sensed that you weren't really giving your all during our missions.
records.en: I kind of sensed that you weren't really giving your<CR>all during our missions.

records.jp: けど、どうやってそんな力を手に入れたの？
records.en_original: But how did you get that kind of power, anyway?
records.en: But how did you get that kind of power, anyway?

records.jp: ある薬の実験台になってたから。<CR>そのおかげで強化できてるの
records.en_original: I became a test subject for a certain medicine. Thanks to that, I got stronger.
records.en: I became a test subject for a certain medicine.<CR>Thanks to that, I got stronger.

records.jp: へー、そんな便利な薬あったんだ。<CR>司令も早くわたしたちにくれればよかったのに
records.en_original: Wow, there was that convenient of a medicine? Wish the commander had given us some sooner.
records.en: Wow, there was that convenient of a medicine?<CR>Wish the commander had given us some sooner.

records.jp: 司令も知らないはず。この薬は開発途中で、<CR>蓬莱館製薬のごく一部の人間しか知らないから
records.en_original: Even the commander shouldn't know about it. It's still in development, and only a handful of people at Horaikan Pharmaceuticals are aware of it.
records.en: Even the commander shouldn't know about it. It's still in development,<CR>and only a handful of people at Horaikan Pharmaceuticals are aware of it.

records.jp: ……って、ここまで話したら<CR>なんとなくバレちゃうか。私の立場
records.en_original: Oops, maybe I've pretty much given myself away by saying all that. My position, I mean.
records.en: Oops, maybe I've pretty much given myself away by saying all that.<CR>My position, I mean.

records.jp: なるほどね……
records.en_original: I see...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: 私はもう、自分の気持ちを偽らない。<CR>そのために戦う
records.en_original: I'm done lying to myself. I'm going to fight for what I truly feel.
records.en: I'm done lying to myself.<CR>I'm going to fight for what I truly feel.

records.jp: ……たとえ、家族に刃を向けることになっても
records.en_original: Even if it means turning my blade against my own family.
records.en: Even if it means turning my blade against my own family.
